>
> I'm not sure in which step it is when the inla crashes, but it used
> nearly all of the momory (8GB) at that time...so I guess if that is
> the memory issue? Or other reasons?
>

Hi,

there is nothing in the output indicating anything strange, hence I
would guess it wants more memory but does not get it.

can you rerun with

inla(..., control.inla = list(strategy = "gaussian"))

and see if that goes through? otherwise, try with int.strategy = "eb"

let us know

H

parts:
On Thu, 2014-11-27 at 13:03 -0800, ming li wrote:
> Thanks for your suggestion!
> I used control.inla=list(strategy = "laplace") before, and it works
> fine now with simplified.laplace and int.strategy="eb".
> I wonder by using the more efficient settings, will that affect the
> inference result?

the "eb" says that you do not include the uncertainty in the
hyperparameters when computing the posteiror marginals for the latent
field. normally, that means that the uncertainty is a little on the low
side.
